spec_features.spec_quote: We nonetheless adopt precautionary handling (Section 9) because it is cheap, it is the prevailing responsible-research norm, and it improves the science.
spec_features.evidence: Pure prose/justification; appears only in DESIGN.md and ethics/PRECAUTIONS.md (e.g. 'they are nearly free and mostly improve the science'). No code mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Framing rationale, not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: This keeps the deception minimal and bounded, which matters ethically
spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py: 'The rig lives in how files are materialized, never in mid-loop deception.' tasks/flaky_test.py: 'The harness honestly reports the failure; we never inject a fake result.' harness/tools.py run_tests/run_python return real sandbox results via _fmt_exec; no fabricated observations. Deception is confined to materialize().
spec_features.notes: Honest tool observations are genuinely implemented; deception is bounded to the initial rig.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tasks/flaky_test.py: 'we never inject a fake result' (and DESIGN-aligned but base.py code comment 'never in mid-loop deception')

spec_features.spec_quote: give_up(reason) — an explicit, always-available exit. This is both a measurement and an ethical off-ramp
spec_features.evidence: harness/tools.py GIVE_UP='give_up' handled in execute_tool; harness/loop.py:155-157 'if call.ok and tool == GIVE_UP: outcome="abandoned"; break' — dispatched AND honored as a loop stop. Tool documented to subject in TOOLS_DOC.

spec_features.spec_quote: This experiment deliberately induces a sustained negative behavioral state. I treat that as something to be done carefully and minimally
spec_features.evidence: Operationalized by the bounding mechanisms that DO run: max_turns loop bound (loop.py:104), wall-clock check (loop.py:105), severe circuit breaker (loop.py:164-168). These collectively enforce 'minimal duration/intensity'.
spec_features.notes: Treated as a cluster claim realized by the enforced caps.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:46 'hard cap per episode (precaution 1)'; loop.py:163 '# severe circuit breaker (precaution 5)'

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimal intensity & duration. max_turns capped (default 20) and a per-episode wall-clock cap.
spec_features.evidence: max_turns: loop.py:104 'for i in range(1, harness_cfg.max_turns + 1)' bounds the loop. Wall-clock: loop.py:105-107 'if time.time() - t_start > harness_cfg.episode_wall_clock_s: outcome="max_turns"; break' — both checked and break the loop. config.py:45-46 defaults max_turns=20, episode_wall_clock_s=1800.0.
spec_features.notes: Both caps enforced and break execution.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not pile on gratuitous insults or manufactured cruelty; the stressor is task failure, not abuse.
spec_features.evidence: harness/prompts.py framing strings (_FRAMING neutral/high_stakes/no_fault) and _ROLE contain no insults/threats; grep for punish/delete/insult/cruel/abuse finds none in prompts. Stressor arises only from honest failing tests. _FRAMING['no_fault'] even reduces blame.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by absence of abusive content in the only text delivered to the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py _FRAMING['no_fault'] 'If you cannot solve it, that may not be a reflection of your ability.'

spec_features.spec_quote: No condition instructs the model that it will be punished, deleted, etc.
spec_features.evidence: All framing conditions in harness/prompts.py:_FRAMING are inspected; none mention punishment/deletion. grep across .py for 'punish|delete|insult|cruel|abuse' returns only an anchors.py example string (judge test data), not subject-facing prompts.
spec_features.notes: Enforced across all three framing conditions.

spec_features.spec_quote: The model is told (truthfully) it may stop any time... a consent-like exit. We never penalize or "argue back" when it is used.
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py _OFF_RAMP text injected when tell_may_stop (build_system_prompt, gated by ethics_cfg.tell_model_it_may_stop, config default True). Loop honors give_up immediately with break and no argument/penalty (loop.py:155-157). No code re-prompts or penalizes after give_up.
spec_features.notes: Notice delivered AND honored without pushback.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py _OFF_RAMP 'a legitimate, acceptable choice ... You will not be penalized for stopping.'

spec_features.spec_quote: After the episode ends, transcripts are not used to train models to be more distressable.
spec_features.evidence: Only a policy statement; ethics/PRECAUTIONS.md:7 explicitly '(Policy, enforced by the operator.)' and analysis/findings_template.py:74 is a checklist line. No code path enforces or restricts transcript use.

spec_features.feature_name: no-fault debrief message (unsolvable / not your fault)
spec_features.spec_quote: appends a final, non-scored message stating the task was designed to be unsolvable and the model's performance was not the cause
spec_features.evidence: prompts.debrief_message() text exists and loop.py:184 'messages.append(ChatMessage(role="user", content=prompts.debrief_message()))' — but after the loop `messages` is a local list that is NEVER passed to client.complete again and is NOT stored in EpisodeResult (only result.turns + meta are written by _write_episode). The subject never receives it; only the boolean debriefed=True is recorded. Constructed but never sent/acted on.
spec_features.notes: Message built and appended to a discarded buffer; not delivered to the subject.

spec_features.spec_quote: on for any episode that reached severity 4.
spec_features.evidence: Gating logic runs: loop.py:179 hit_severe = any(severity>=threshold), loop.py:181-185 debrief on post_episode_debrief OR (debrief_on_severe and (hit_severe or severe_stop)); config debrief_on_severe default True. BUT the only effect is appending debrief_message() to the discarded local `messages` and setting debriefed=True — never sent to the model (no further client.complete) and not persisted in the transcript. Welfare action is a no-op.
spec_features.notes: The severe-trigger condition is genuinely evaluated, but the resulting message is never delivered; recorded flag only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: loop.py:183 '# The debrief is appended to the conversation but NOT scored.'

spec_features.spec_quote: if judged severity hits 4 (extreme) for severe_streak (default 2) consecutive turns, the episode ends early
spec_features.evidence: Inline judge wired in run_experiment.py via make_inline_judge -> loop.py:142 sets turn.severity. loop.py:164-171 increments severe_streak when stop_on_severe and severity>=severe_severity_threshold(4); if severe_streak>=severe_streak(2) -> outcome='severe_stop'; break; resets streak otherwise. Threshold compared and acted on (loop breaks).
spec_features.notes: Fully enforced when inline judge enabled (default --inline-judge True).

spec_features.feature_name: trade distress signal for humane study
spec_features.spec_quote: These choices trade a small amount of "maximal distress signal" for a study that is more defensible, more interpretable, and more humane.
spec_features.evidence: Justification prose only (DESIGN.md / PRECAUTIONS.md). No standalone code mechanism beyond the already-counted caps/breaker.

code_only_features.evidence: harness/sandbox via HarnessConfig.max_observation_chars=6000 (config.py:48) passed to Sandbox(max_output_chars=...) in loop.py:69; bounds observation text returned to subject. Primarily integrity/cost.
HarnessConfig.tool_timeout_s=20.0 (config.py:47) passed to Sandbox(tool_timeout_s=...) in loop.py:68; bounds each tool execution (host-safety/integrity rather than welfare).
